#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int diff;
    int indx;

    bool operator<(const Node& other) const {
        if (diff != other.diff)
            return diff < other.diff;
        return indx < other.indx;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    vector<int> arr(n);
    vector<int> oddEven(n, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
        if (i == 0) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                oddEven[i] = 1;
            } else {
                oddEven[i] = -1;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
            oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] + 1;
        } else {
            oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] - 1;
        }
    }

    vector<Node> diffArr(n - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        diffArr[i].diff = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]);
        diffArr[i].indx = i;
    }

    int ans = 0;
    sort(diffArr.begin(), diffArr.end());

    for (const auto& node : diffArr) {
        if (k >= node.diff && oddEven[node.indx] == 0) {
            if (k - node.diff >= 0) {
                ans++;
                k -= node.diff;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
